title: Michigan Water Heater Rebates 2026: Utility and City Offers
desc: Michigan water heater rebates in 2026: Ann Arbor's city rebate pays $1,000, Lansing BWL pays $500 to $1,000, and DTE and Consumers offer instant discounts with no printed amount.
lead: Michigan has no single statewide water heater rebate. What you can get depends on your city and your utility. Ann Arbor pays $1,000 for a heat pump water heater, Lansing's Board of Water & Light pays $500 to $1,000, and DTE Energy and Consumers Energy offer instant discounts that their pages do not put a dollar amount on. We read each page on October 6, 2026.
cards_heading: What helps pay for a water heater in Michigan in 2026
cards_intro: Each card names the fact we keep on file. Where an official page shows no dollar amount, we say so instead of guessing.

cards.title: Ann Arbor A2ZERO heat pump water heater
cards.note: Needs a UEF rating of 2.0 or higher and contractor installation. For homes in the City of Ann Arbor.

cards.title: Lansing BWL heat pump water heater
cards.note: BWL's electrification page says $1,000 and its 2026 form says $500. ENERGY STAR certified. Ask BWL which applies.

cards.title: DTE Energy instant discount
cards.note: ENERGY STAR heat pump water heater (2.2 UEF or better) for electric customers, or ENERGY STAR gas models for gas customers. Funds are first come, first served.

cards.title: Consumers Energy instant rebate
cards.note: ENERGY STAR gas and gas tankless water heaters, and heat pump water heaters up to 55 gallons for electric customers, through a participating contractor.

cards.title: State rebates (MiHER)
cards.note: The state program lists water heaters. New income-qualified applications are paused in the Detroit, Warren, Grand Rapids, Lansing and Kalamazoo districts.

cards.title: Federal 25C and 25D tax credits
cards.note: The federal home energy credits ended for work finished after December 31, 2025.

sections: Why we show no amount for DTE and Consumers

Both utilities say they give an instant discount through a participating contractor or retailer, and neither page prints a dollar figure. Sites that quote a number are quoting older or third-party figures. We will not print an amount we could not read on the official page. Ask the contractor for the discount in writing, with the model number, before you sign.

A heat pump water heater uses much less electricity than a regular electric tank. It can make sense in a gas home too, but running cost depends on your gas and electric prices. Ask your installer for a comparison based on your own bills. The rebates above are mostly aimed at electric units, and both DTE and Consumers also list gas models.

DTE asks for an ENERGY STAR heat pump water heater with at least a 2.2 UEF rating. Consumers asks for more than 2.2 UEF and a size up to 55 gallons. Ann Arbor asks for 2.0 or higher. Lansing BWL asks for ENERGY STAR and, on one page, 3.0 UEF. UEF is a score for how efficient a water heater is. A higher score means lower running cost.

DTE's Energy Efficiency Assistance lists high efficiency water heaters among its free upgrades for households at or below 250% of the federal poverty level. Look at the free programs before you buy a heater yourself.
claim_heading: How to get a water heater rebate in Michigan
claim_steps: Check which utility and which city you are in.
If you are in Ann Arbor, reserve the city rebate before you buy.
In Lansing, ask BWL which amount applies and keep the answer.
For DTE and Consumers, use a participating contractor or the retail discount page.
Keep the invoice, model number and specification sheet.

faq: Is there a statewide water heater rebate in Michigan?
Not a utility one. Michigan's MiHER program lists water heaters, but new income-qualified applications are paused in five districts.
How much is the Ann Arbor water heater rebate?
$1,000, or $2,000 for households at or below 120% of area median income, for a heat pump water heater with a UEF of 2.0 or higher.
BWL's electrification page says $1,000 and its 2026 form says $500. Confirm with BWL before you buy.
Does the federal tax credit still apply?
No. It ended for work finished after December 31, 2025.
You pay the contractor. The rebate or instant discount lowers the cost.
